shared_contract: s2i slot contract stated on X509V3ExtMethod (src/x509/v3_lib.rs). do_ext_nconf holds RegistryReadGuard across the whole dispatch (src/x509/v3_conf.rs:1035), so the row resolved through X509V3_EXT_get_nid stays live across the lookup, the s2i callback and the encoder; it refuses ext_nid == NID_undef (:1007) and a NULL row (:1014). The s2i arm does not parse or pre-validate the value: it calls cb(method, ctx, value) at :1097 with the caller's NUL-terminated config string, which the callback must consume read-only and must not free or retain. On a non-NULL result the dispatcher encodes through do_ext_i2d (:1126) and releases with ASN1_item_free(ext_struc, it()) or ext_free (:1127-1131). The callback must return a fresh object of exactly the row's `it` type, releasing any partial value itself on failure.

entry_points: X509V3_EXT_nconf_nid (src/x509/v3_conf.rs:1212) -> do_ext_nconf(:998); this is the entry the tests drive.
X509V3_EXT_conf (:1426) and X509V3_EXT_conf_nid (:1455) build a temporary NCONF and call the two above.
X509V3_EXT_add_nconf_sk (:1245) walks a config section and calls X509V3_EXT_nconf_int(:1291).
dispatch_paths.lookup: X509V3_EXT_get_nid (src/x509/v3_lib.rs:748) returns a BORROWED row; do_ext_nconf takes its own RegistryReadGuard at :1035 and holds it across the s2i slot and do_ext_i2d, so a concurrent X509V3_EXT_cleanup cannot release a DYNAMIC row for the whole dispatch.
dispatch_paths.values: The s2i arm has no parsed stack: `value` is the caller's NUL-terminated configuration string, borrowed, not owned by the dispatcher. NULL handling is the callback's (the five ASN1_NULL rows and s2i_NO_ASSERTION ignore it; s2i_ASN1_INTEGER/IA5/UTF8 refuse it).
dispatch_paths.guard: NID_undef (:1007), NULL row (:1014) and the read-hold acquisition (:1035) precede the s2i slot.

row_liveness.question: Does the registry read hold span the s2i dispatch, as B51 proved for v2i?
row_liveness.answer: YES, ENFORCED. B51b's RegistryReadGuard in do_ext_nconf already covers the s2i branch at :1095; B52 adds the branch-specific canary B52-C1 because B51's tests exercised only the v2i arm. A concurrent X509V3_EXT_cleanup cannot release a DYNAMIC row under the callback.
row_liveness.enforcement: src/x509/v3_conf.rs do_ext_nconf (:1035), RAII drop on every path. B52 adds no new production hold.
row_liveness.observation: A #[cfg(test)] thread-local probe (v3_lib.rs read_hold_probe) is incremented by RegistryReadGuard::acquire and decremented by Drop; the B52 s2i probe callback records it on entry. A neutral control asserts the probe is false before dispatch.
row_liveness.static_rows: The nine rows are process-lifetime pub static values reached through STANDARD_EXTS; X509V3_EXT_cleanup cannot release them. The canary uses a caller-owned Box::leak row registered under a fresh NID so the callback is reached through the registry, not called directly.

defect_class: uncontracted unsafe fn definitions at nine X509_VERIFY_POLICY s2i sites, plus a missing shared s2i slot contract. Each callback carried a block-level description but no fn-level # Safety. The dispatcher evidence is unchanged; no functional defect was found. The production delta is documentation only. The ia5_s2i and utf8_s2i in-body comments were also corrected: they cited the i2s slot contract for a `*const c_char` argument.

boundaries.contract: The `s2i` slot contract stated on X509V3ExtMethod (src/x509/v3_lib.rs). Caller do_ext_nconf's `s2i` arm (src/x509/v3_conf.rs:1095) establishes: `method` is a live borrowed row resolved under the registry read hold; `value` is the caller's NUL-terminated configuration string, borrowed for the call; `ctx` is NULL or live. This body reads none of them and returns ASN1_NULL_new(), the authority's `(ASN1_VALUE *)1` sentinel. On success the dispatcher encodes it with the row's ASN1_NULL_it and releases it once at :1127-1131 (ASN1_NULL_it's free is the authority's no-op). ASN1_NULL_new is a constant return and cannot fail. The returned type must match the row's `it`, and any `usr_data` meaning is the registrar's obligation. Row liveness while the callback runs is enforced by the dispatcher's registry read hold (B51-R1), so the caller need not exclude X509V3_EXT_cleanup during the call. X509V3_EXT_add still borrows caller-owned row storage, and a callback must not call a registry writer (B51-R9).
established: do_ext_nconf resolves `method` through X509V3_EXT_get_nid under its own RegistryReadGuard and refuses ext_nid == NID_undef and a NULL row (:1007-1018).

A non-NULL result is encoded by do_ext_i2d at :1126 and released exactly once with the row's own `it` (ASN1_item_free) or `ext_free` at :1127-1131.

hidden_obligations_note: No hidden obligation was found. Every duty the callbacks do not enforce is stated in each contract and enumerated as a residual: (1) a caller-registered callback must not call a registry writer, because the read hold is non-reentrant (B51-R9); (2) caller-owned row storage must outlive registration (X509V3_EXT_add's own Safety block); (3) the returned object's type must match the row's `it` and any `usr_data` meaning (registrar obligation); (4) `ctx` is NULL-or-live where read (these nine do not read it). Row liveness for a DYNAMIC row is enforced, not an obligation.
new_unsafe_assumptions_note: No production unsafe fn or exported item was added. The only new unsafe definitions are test-only: one #[cfg(test)] s2i probe callback and its unsafe blocks, compiled out of every non-test build.
test_only_unsafe_added_note: One #[cfg(test)] unsafe extern "C" s2i probe callback (hold_probe_s2i) in src/x509/v3_conf.rs's test module; absent from non-test builds.
boundary_size: 9 callback bodies (unchanged), 9 fn-level # Safety contracts, one shared `## s2i` slot-contract section (v3_lib.rs), and 3 tests (a 9-row end-to-end loop, an int reject, and an s2i-arm liveness canary). No production unsafe operation added or removed.
safe_callers_can_cause_ub_note: Every entry point that can reach an s2i callback is `unsafe extern "C"` (X509V3_EXT_nconf, X509V3_EXT_nconf_nid, X509V3_EXT_conf, X509V3_EXT_conf_nid, X509V3_EXT_add_nconf_sk). The callback type is Option<unsafe extern "C" fn>, and no safe Rust item accepts or returns X509V3ExtMethod, so a safe Rust caller cannot reach these callbacks without an unsafe block.
